scope: Security engineering skills in the community library

skills.name: Sigma
skills.inputs: A behavior description or cited report, representative events, logging source, target backend, and any existing processing pipeline.
skills.outputs: Sigma YAML, source-to-rule rationale, field dependencies, conversion assumptions, positive/negative test requirements and validation status.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: KQL Detection
skills.inputs: The target Microsoft detection product, verified tables and fields, representative events, detection hypothesis and intended schedule.
skills.outputs: KQL query, product-specific rule configuration, telemetry requirements, entity mapping, test plan and deployment-readiness assessment.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: SPL Detection
skills.inputs: Splunk deployment and detection type, indexes/sourcetypes or CIM data model, sample events, existing macros/lookups and a behavior hypothesis.
skills.outputs: SPL search, dependencies, scheduling and grouping choices, validation evidence and a reviewable detection content package.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Rule Tests
skills.inputs: A specific rule version, target engine/version, field mappings and representative malicious and legitimate telemetry.
skills.outputs: A test manifest, fixtures or fixture references, backend-appropriate assertions, execution instructions and result limitations.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Rule Tuning
skills.inputs: Current rule/version, adjudicated alerts, sampled underlying events, intended behavior, environment context and candidate exceptions.
skills.outputs: A minimal tuning diff, before/after cohort metrics, positive regressions, exception ownership/expiry and rollout/rollback guidance.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Detection Replay
skills.inputs: Rule and mapping versions, recorded dataset with provenance, expected outcomes, target lab/backend and time-handling requirements.
skills.outputs: A reproducible replay plan or actual run record with input identity, transformations, matched evidence and validation gaps.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Log Parser
skills.inputs: Representative raw records including malformed and multiline examples, source format/version, target parser engine and expected output contract.
skills.outputs: Parser code or pipeline, field/type contract, explicit failure handling, reproducible parser tests and operational limits.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Field Mapping
skills.inputs: Source field documentation and representative events, a named target schema/version, required downstream detections and mapping constraints.
skills.outputs: Source-to-target mapping specification, transformation logic, unresolved semantics, validation cases and downstream impact notes.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Log Quality
skills.inputs: Security log export or confirmed query access, required fields, source inventory, timestamp definitions and the period being assessed.
skills.outputs: Measured quality profile with denominators, affected detection dependencies, evidence-supported causes and prioritized remediation checks.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.

skills.name: Feed Quality
skills.inputs: An intelligence export or authorized feed connection, provider field definitions, evaluation date, indicator types and the intended operational use.
skills.outputs: A feed quality assessment, normalization and provenance gaps, overlap/age metrics, policy recommendations and limitations on maliciousness claims.
skills.external_connections: Optional; separately configured and authorized. No connector is bundled.
